description: Capture a token-efficient interactive accessibility snapshot of the page with numbered element references (@1, @2, etc.). Supports pre-snapshot waitMs/waitForSelector/waitForText so you can wait for SPA rendering and snapshot in a single call.

maxElements.description: Maximum number of interactive elements to include (default: 80)

sleepMs.description: Alias for waitMs: milliseconds to sleep before taking snapshot

waitForSelector.description: Optional CSS selector or @ref to wait for before taking snapshot

waitForText.description: Optional text to wait for on the page before taking snapshot

waitMs.description: Optional milliseconds to wait/sleep before taking snapshot

waitUntil.description: Wait for tab load completion before taking snapshot (default: true)
